items.vanilla_en: I worked with a girl from Neon at Argos. Man, did she have some crazy stories!

items.vanilla_en: Help the UC out here.

items.vanilla_en: Just so you know, the Ecliptic would've gunned for you after they took us out.

items.vanilla_en: I think you could safely say that most of Neon would agree.

items.vanilla_en: Neon Security is like one level of dirt above the mud on the ocean floor.
items.vanilla_ko: 네온 경비대는 바다 바닥 진흙보다 한 단계 위 수준이에요.

items.vanilla_en: When UC Security loses an officer, I make it my responsibility to call their family... I've got a lot of calls to make now.
items.vanilla_ko: 식민지 연합 경비대원이 전사하면, 그 가족에게 연락하는 걸 제 책임으로 삼고 있어요... 이제 많은 전화를 해야 할 것 같네요.

items.vanilla_en: When I get back to Neon, I'll whip up some practice targets with your face printed on them. Should give me ample motivation for a few bullseyes.
items.vanilla_ko: 네온으로 돌아가면 그쪽 얼굴을 잔뜩 인쇄해서 사격 표적으로 연습할게. 명중시키는 데 완벽한 동기부여가 되겠는걸?

items.vanilla_en: No argument here. House Va'ruun seem like nothing but a bunch of madmen.
items.vanilla_ko: 반론의 여지가 없네요. 바룬 가문은 그저 미치광이들의 집단처럼 보여요.

items.vanilla_en: This is UC property. You're not authorized to be here.

items.vanilla_en: Plenty more competition for stores like mine, that's for sure. UC had a lot more money to throw around in those days.
items.vanilla_ko: 제 같은 가게에 경쟁자가 훨씬 더 많았죠. 그때는 식민지 연합에 돈이 훨씬 더 많았으니까요.

items.vanilla_en: Sure is. Mars is rich with mineral deposits, even this close to the city.
items.vanilla_ko: 네, 맞아요. 화성은 도시와 이렇게 가까운 곳에서도 광물 매장량이 풍부해요.

items.vanilla_en: If House Va'ruun abandons you now, they're making a huge mistake.
items.vanilla_ko: 만약 바룬 가문이 지금 너를 버린다면 그건 그자들의 큰 실수가 될 거야.

items.vanilla_en: We can say pirates followed you to Mars and tried to steal the goods, but you fended them off.
items.vanilla_ko: 해적들이 널 화성까지 쫓아와서 물건을 훔치려고 했는데, 네가 막아냈다고 말하자.

items.vanilla_en: I've survived on Neon far too long to take any chances.

items.vanilla_en: So you're really willing to trust the UC after all they've done?
